items.title: Show HN: Learn Languages with Dual Subtitles
items.contentSnippet:
I am not sure how many here have tried Duolingo for French, but I actually had a hard time speaking in the real world. For me, it is definitely a huge issue. I have level 60, travelled to Paris, and couldn't speak except a few words.
I am Georgian, and nobody taught me how to speak English. I only learned it by watching Game of Thrones multiple times, just using English subtitles and audio for many years, switching between Georgian and English. Watching the same episodes again really helped.
Dua

items.title: Show HN: Browser extension shows where to buy current domain name
items.contentSnippet:
Domain Hunter finds if and where you can buy the current domain name loaded in the browser.
Or if you're searching for a domain name on a registrar/aftermarket, it auto-detects the searched domain and finds the best prices.
It uses the domain inventory data aggregated by DomDB.com. And shows other info like registered extensions, keywords, DNS records, etc.
No domain lookups are ever logged - only IP addresses are logged to prevent abuse, which are deleted after 2 weeks.
Website: https://domdb.c
